learning_outcomes.text: The student will be able to develop methodologies related to the execution of engineering projects
The student will be able to synthesize the work developed
The student will be able to make decisions
The student will be able to defend the work carried out before a committee

Ability to draft, sign and develop projects in the field of Mechanical Engineering aimed at the construction, renovation, repair, conservation, demolition, manufacturing, installation, assembly or operation of: structures, mechanical equipment, energy installations, electrical and electronic installations, industrial installations and plants and manufacturing and automation processes.
Ability to manage the activities subject to the engineering projects described in the previous section.
Knowledge in basic and technological subjects, enabling them to learn new methods and theories, and providing them with versatility to adapt to new situations.
Ability to solve problems with initiative, decision-making, creativity, critical reasoning and to communicate and transmit knowledge, skills and abilities in the field of Mechanical Engineering.
Knowledge for carrying out measurements, calculations, valuations, appraisals, expert reports, studies, reports, work plans and other similar tasks.
Ability to handle specifications, regulations and mandatory standards.
Ability to analyze and evaluate the social and environmental impact of technical solutions.
Ability to apply quality principles and methods.
Ability to organize and plan within the company, and other institutions and organizations.
Ability to work in a multilingual and multidisciplinary environment.
Knowledge, understanding and ability to apply the necessary legislation in the exercise of the profession of Industrial Technical Engineer.
Basic knowledge and application of environmental technologies and sustainability.
Knowledge and abilities to organize and manage projects. Understand the organizational structure and functions of a project office.
Knowledge and abilities to apply graphic engineering techniques.
Knowledge and abilities for the calculation, design and testing of machines.
Applied knowledge of thermal engineering.
Knowledge and ability for the calculation and design of industrial structures and constructions.
Applied knowledge of the fundamentals of fluid-mechanical systems and machines.
Knowledge and abilities for the application of materials engineering.
Applied knowledge of manufacturing systems and processes, metrology and quality control.

Ability to individually carry out, present and defend before a university committee, a project in the field of specific Mechanical Engineering technologies of a professional nature in which the competencies acquired in the teachings are synthesized and integrated.

syllabus_topics: Development of the Final Degree Project
teaching_methods: Problem-based learning: Develop active learning through problem-solving that encourages student thinking and/or experimentation, as well as decision-making.
Project-oriented learning: Carrying out a project to solve a problem, applying acquired knowledge and fostering skills related to planning, design, carrying out activities and obtaining conclusions.
Exercise and problem solving: Practice, rehearse and put previous knowledge into practice through routine repetition.
assessment_rules: The evaluating committee will establish the evaluation criteria, based on the EPSE regulations developed for this purpose. The evaluating committee will establish the characteristics of the evaluation test and the correction criteria, based on the specific regulations of the Escuela Politécnica Superior de Elche. Information on the presentation and evaluation procedure for the TFG can be found at https://epse.umh.es/tfgm/.
